title: Not the best
text: Not the best. I guess you get what you pay for. I use a dishwasher for the most part, and after each wash these have not only terrible water spots, but rust spots as well. It’s stainless steel so they come off, but still very annoying and a good indicator that they won’t last long. They feel like low quality restaurant silverware that would be bought knowing it’ll be replaced in a month. Could be good for a one night event or large party I guess.
